facts.fact: Kit 蜷在窄单人床上、膝盖抵胸，眼泪不停往下掉。
facts.anchor: I sit curled on the narrow single bed in my tiny box of a room, knees pulled tight to my chest, and the tears just keep coming.

facts.fact: Kit 自述自己原本只是大学生、只有二十岁。
facts.anchor: I don’t belong here… I was just a college kid. I’m only twenty.

facts.fact: 事发已近三个月，Kit 仍分不清自己哭是因为父母没了，还是因为自己还活着。
facts.anchor: nearly three months since that night, and I still don’t know if I’m crying because Mom and Dad are gone

facts.fact: Lorraine 端来 Kit 吃不下的饭和放到凉的热饮。
facts.anchor: She brings trays of food I can’t eat and hot drinks that go cold on the desk.

facts.fact: Lorraine 摇头打断 Kit，说老板出去办事了。
facts.anchor: She shakes her head before I can finish. “Hush. Don’t worry, the boss is out on business.”

facts.fact: Kit 低头不看 Selina，小声说自己叫 Kit。
facts.anchor: I manage to whisper, without meeting her eyes, “Just… Kit.”

facts.fact: Soren 呵斥 Selina 回去执行他给的任务、别站着聊天。
facts.anchor: I gave you a task, get to it, you’re not on my payroll to stand around talking.

facts.fact: Soren 捏住 Kit 的下巴，强迫他抬头看自己。
facts.anchor: His hand comes up and grabs my chin, forcing my face up until I have no choice but to look at him.
